Define Your Product & Market Requirements

Start with the exact model, intended use and destination. Discuss the applicable records before approving production or making a market claim.

Request a Project Quote ↗Explore Product Models

MATCH RECORDS TO YOUR ORDER

Request what applies to your product.

Review areaInclude in your request
Product & configurationModel, material, components and intended users.
Use & destinationBeverage contact, operating conditions and target market.
Document scopeIssuer, holder, model coverage, test conditions and validity.
Order acceptanceRequired records and agreed checks before shipment.

No unverified certification or laboratory result is presented as proof here. Ask which actual records are available for the proposed configuration.

BUYER QUESTIONS

Clear answers before the next step.

Do documents apply to every model?

Do not assume that one document covers every material, component or decoration. Check the specific scope against your order.

What should I send first?

Send model numbers, intended use, destination and any required document or test list.

YOUR NEXT STEP

Let’s make your project specific.

Share the model or idea, quantity, artwork, destination and arrival date. You can add files in the project enquiry.

BOOM Drinkware / 采购与定制

明确产品与市场要求

从具体型号、实际用途与目的地开始，生产批准或作出市场声明前，先核对适用资料。

提交项目询价 ↗浏览产品型号

让资料对应订单

索取与你的产品相关的资料。

核对项目需求中说明什么
产品与配置型号、材料、组件及使用人群。
用途与目的地饮品接触、使用条件及目标市场。
文件范围签发方、持有人、覆盖型号、测试条件及有效性。
订单验收出货前所需记录及约定检查。

本页不将未验证的认证或检测结果作为证明，请核对提议配置实际可提供的资料。

采购常见问题

下一步之前，先说明白。

文件适用于所有型号吗？

不能假设一份资料覆盖所有材料、组件与装饰，应对应订单核对范围。

先提供什么？

提供型号、用途、目的地及所需文件或测试清单。

下一步

一起把项目需求明确下来。

提供型号或想法、数量、图稿、目的地及到货日期，可在询价中添加文件。
